title: New Suspects Identified in Ayotzinapa Case, Le Monde Reports
detail: French newspaper Le Monde reports that new suspects have been identified in the Ayotzinapa case involving the 2014 forced disappearance of 43 normalista students, signaling an advance in Mexico's ongoing investigation. The case — a long-standing human rights priority — gained renewed attention ahead of the 12th anniversary of the tragedy. President Sheinbaum had stated on September 28 that the investigation remains open.
